title: 第5章 小龙象功第6章 满月宴

“二苟，在家吗？”
许川步入陈二苟家的院子。
农忙结束，陈二苟此时正悠闲地躺在屋檐下的一张躺椅上。
见到许川，蹭的一下弹了起来，惊讶道：“川哥，你怎么来了，不在家陪嫂子吗？”
“我给她吃了你带来的气血丹，现在已经恢复的差不多了。”
“原来如此。”
“大牛，芳芳，你许伯伯来了，快点出来。”
两个差不多大的娃儿走出来后，对着许川脆生生喊道：“许伯伯。”
“真乖。”许川微微一笑。
“进去玩吧。”
听到陈二苟的话，两娃顿时欢天喜地跑了进去。
许川默默掏出一张百两的银票，递了过去。
“川哥，你这是。”
“气血丹的钱，我知道气血丹价格不菲，没有武馆门路，有钱也买不到，这钱你必须收下，否则日后别喊我川哥。”
一句话就把陈二苟后面要说的都堵了回去。
“那我就收下了。”
见陈二苟收起，许川问道：“上次你说有什么事想找我帮忙，说说看？”
“我兄长想要用内劲秘籍交换青玉梨的栽培方法，你觉得行吗？”
陈二苟犹豫了半晌开口道。

早年许川要种青玉梨，没有人看好。
但是去年听说许川卖了不少青玉梨给徐家，他们这才知道他种植青玉梨成功了。
洞溪村许多黎庶都十分羡慕。
“陈伯的意思？”
“不不不。”
陈二苟连忙摆手，“我爹不同意，是我兄长的想法。”
“估计是听说你种植了十亩的青玉梨，每年都有不少银子进益，所以.....”
他说话越来越小声，最后都不敢看许川的眼睛。
陈二苟心中也是无奈。
但他从小就怕他大哥，现在他成了武者，就更怕了。
只能来当这个说客。
不过，他也明白，先不说许川有没有这秘方，即便有，那也是下蛋的金母鸡，怎么可能是一本内劲秘籍可比的。
“川哥，你别生气，我也就这么一提。”
“其实我都有些后悔替我哥说项了，毕竟这是你独门的手艺，赖以生存的根本，仅仅交换一本秘籍也太吃亏了。”
许川想到了许妍。
陈二苟是老实的，但许妍十分的精明。
是那种没有好处都不会跟你多聊几句的类型。
许川的确算得上是她的堂兄，但两家人早就出了五服，在他爷爷那代就不怎么来往了。

"Ergou, are you at home?"
Xu Chuan walked into the courtyard of Chen Ergou's house.
The busy farming season was over, and Chen Ergou was lying leisurely on a deck chair under the eaves.
Seeing Xu Chuan, he jumped up and said in surprise: "Brother Chuan, why are you here? Aren't you at home with your sister-in-law?"
"I gave her the Qi and Blood Pill you brought, and she's almost recovered now."
"That's it."
"Daniu, Fangfang, your Uncle Xu is here, come out quickly."
After the two babies of about the same age came out, they shouted to Xu Chuan: "Uncle Xu."
"So good." Xu Chuan smiled slightly.
"Let's go in and play."
After hearing Chen Ergou's words, the two children immediately ran in happily.
Xu Chuan silently took out a one hundred tael silver note and handed it over.
"Brother Chuan, this is what you are doing."
"The money for Qi and Blood Pills, I know that Qi and Blood Pills are expensive. You can't buy them even if you don't have a martial arts school connection, and you have money. You must accept this money, otherwise don't call me Brother Chuan in the future."
In one sentence, Chen Ergou blocked up everything he wanted to say next.
"Then I'll accept it."
Seeing Chen Ergou put away, Xu Chuan asked: "Last time you said you wanted to ask me for help with something, tell me?"
"My brother wants to exchange the inner strength secret book for the cultivation method of Qingyu pear. Do you think it's okay?"
Chen Ergou hesitated for a long time before speaking.
In the early years, Xu Chuan wanted to plant green jade pears, but no one was optimistic about it.
But last year I heard that Xu Chuan sold a lot of green jade pears to the Xu family, and then they knew that he had succeeded in growing green jade pears.
Many common people in Dongxi Village are very envious.
"What do you mean, Uncle Chen?"
"No no no."
Chen Ergou waved his hand quickly, "My father doesn't agree, it's my brother's idea."
"I guess I heard that you planted ten acres of green jade pears and you make a lot of money every year, so..."
He spoke more and more quietly, and in the end he did not dare to look into Xu Chuan's eyes.
Chen Ergou felt helpless.
But he has been afraid of his elder brother since he was a child, and now that he has become a warrior, he is even more afraid.
I can only come here as a lobbyist.
However, he also understood that, let alone whether Xu Chuan had this secret recipe, even if he did, it was just a golden hen that lays eggs. How could it be comparable to a secret book of inner strength.
"Brother Chuan, don't be angry, that's all I mentioned."
"Actually, I regret speaking up for my brother. After all, this is your unique craft and the basis for your survival. Just exchanging a secret book is too much of a disadvantage."
Xu Chuan thought of Xu Yan.
Chen Ergou is honest, but Xu Yan is very shrewd.
He's the type who won't talk to you for more than a few words if there's no benefit.
Xu Chuan was indeed her cousin, but the two families had been on the fifth server for a long time, and they didn't have much contact with each other in his grandfather's generation.
